title: Conversation
question: Question about authorized sources
failed: Result unavailable; the draft was not promoted
prepared: Context prepared — nothing sent to the generator
coverage: Coverage: retrieved chunks only; this is not a full reading of the collection.
excluded: Chunks excluded by budget / overlap / limit
contextLimit: Model context limit (tokens, declared by you)
estimateHelp: Method utf8-bytes-plus-overhead-v1: UTF-8 bytes plus framing allowance; an image adds a 4,096-token estimate. This is not a tokenizer count or a guarantee against truncation. Check the model limit. Complete history is included or preparation fails.
exactContext: Inspect all context to be sent
consent: I authorize these categories for this provider and notebook
consentSaved: Consent saved for the displayed destination and revision
apiBlocked: Potentially paid APIs are blocked in settings
validAnchor: Valid anchor: existence and excerpt verified
general: General knowledge; not data extracted from sources
visualProposal: Proposed visual interpretation; not a literal textual quotation
visionDisabled: Visual analysis disabled: the selected model does not declare image support.
useImage: Include the page/region from the local preview
noPreview: Render a page/region in Documents to prepare a visual analysis.
noModel: Select a model; reading and lexical search remain available.
capabilityHelp: These declarations are not probes or server-provided evidence. No automatic test or download occurs.
localTrust: LOCAL accepts loopback endpoints only. Evidra does not control whether a third-party runner forwards data to cloud; explicitly cloud models are rejected.
blockPaid: Block potentially paid APIs (including free tiers)
memoryOnly: Keep only in this session's memory
budgetHelp: A ceiling blocks sending without reliable pricing and a verified input count. The context estimate does not authorize a monetary reservation.
think: Enable Ollama thinking (not stored as reasoning)
transportUncertain: Transport failure: outcome is uncertain. Check the same run; there is no automatic resend.
